description: Implementation of a test tool class 'SimpleFramerVisitor' for processing and inspecting QUIC protocol packets in tests.

classes.name: SimpleFramerVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class implementing QuicFramerVisitorInterface for testing, capturing various packet events and frames.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a packet using the internal framer and visitor.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the visitor to a new instance.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the packet header captured during processing.

methods.name: version_negotiation_packet
methods.description: Returns the version negotiation packet if any.

methods.name: last_decrypted_level
methods.description: Returns the last decryption level of a processed packet.

methods.name: framer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal QuicFramer instance.

methods.name: num_frames
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames captured.

methods.name: coalesced_packet
methods.description: Returns the coalesced packet if any.
